long_context_note: A model's long_context rates apply only when ONE request's prompt (input + cache read + cache write tokens) exceeds its threshold_input_tokens; cache multipliers then apply to the long-context input rate. Aggregate session or task-profile totals must never trigger it.

claude-fable-5-1.notes: Current frontier model for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Adaptive thinking is always on. Cache reads are priced at 0.025x input (the global 0.1x field remains the fallback for earlier models).

claude-fable-5.notes: Superseded by Fable 5.1 as the default frontier choice. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Current default for most workloads and long-running agentic coding or knowledge work. Adaptive thinking is always on. Cache reads are priced at 0.05x input (the global 0.1x field remains the fallback for earlier models).

claude-opus-5.notes: Superseded by Opus 5.5 as the default Opus choice. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Superseded by Opus 5.5 as the default Opus choice. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-opus-4-7.notes: Previous-generation Opus. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Current speed-and-intelligence workhorse; successor to Sonnet 5 at the same per-token price. Adaptive thinking; default effort is high, with levels recalibrated from Sonnet 5. Cache reads follow the global 0.1x field: the pricing page's model table lists $0.20/MTok, though its prompt-caching section says 0.05x ($0.10) -- recheck at the next refresh.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: Superseded by Sonnet 5.5 as the default Sonnet choice at the same per-token price. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Superseded by Sonnet 5 as the default Sonnet choice. Retained for historical transcript costing and explicit compatibility pins where the provider still supports it.

claude-haiku-4-5.notes: Listed before Haiku 5.5 so the haiku tier word keeps resolving here until Claude Code can dispatch Haiku 5.5; move Haiku 5.5 above this row to make it the tier default. 200K context ceiling -- not for large-repo agentic work.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: For high-volume, latency-sensitive classification, extraction and routing. Priced by prompt length: the base rates cover prompts up to 100,000 tokens; long_context applies above that (see long_context_note). Adaptive thinking; default effort is medium. Not the haiku tier default yet -- see Haiku 4.5's note.
